title: No Detectable Change in Side-Level WER from Prompt-Level Context: A Preregistered Ablation on a Production Oral-History Corpus
abstract: arXiv:2608.28875v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Supplying context at inference time to a large multimodal model is an inexpensive lever for adapting speech transcription to a domain, and earlier results on smaller models reported large gains. This work tested that mechanism where it ships, in the prompt-conditioning layer of a production oral-history transcription tool, on a sample from its own production corpus. Full prompt-level context did not detectably change side-level word error rate (WER), and none of the four preregistered hypotheses was supported. The design was a within-item paired ablation, preregistered with the analysis code frozen by hash before the confirmatory batch was scored; two disclosed gpt-4o pilot sides had been scored earlier, during scorer development. Nineteen cassette sides, about 10.6 hours of degraded 1970s-80s interview audio, were reprocessed through the production code path under three prompt arms, crossed with two deployed commercial configurations,

translated_title: 提示级上下文对磁带单面级词错误率无可检测变化：一项基于生产环境口述历史语料库的预注册消融研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.28875v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在推理时向大型多模态模型提供上下文是将语音转录适配到特定领域的一种低成本手段，此前在较小模型上的研究报告了显著的收益。这项工作在该机制实际部署之处——一个生产环境口述历史转录工具的提示条件层——利用其自身生产语料库中的样本对该机制进行了检验。完整的提示级上下文并未对磁带单面级词错误率（WER）产生可检测的变化，四项预注册假设均未获得支持。研究设计为条目内配对消融，在确认批次评分之前已完成预注册，并通过哈希值冻结分析代码；两个公开披露的 gpt-4o 试点单面音频在评分器开发阶段已被评分。十九盘磁带的单面音频，约10.6小时的1970-80年代退化访谈录音，在生产代码路径下于三种提示条件下重新处理，并与两种已部署的商业配置交叉组合，
tldr: 该预注册消融研究表明，在生产环境口述历史转录工具中，提示级上下文并未显著改善磁带单面级词错误率，四项预注册假设均未得到支持。
en_tdlr: A preregistered paired ablation on a production oral-history transcription tool found no detectable change in side-level WER from prompt-level context, with none of the four preregistered hypotheses supported.
